Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime

Record Class IdeRuntimeProvenance

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime.IdeRuntimeProvenance
Record Components:
schemaVersion - Provenance document schema version.
moduleDirectory - Canonical owning module directory.
executionId - Maven execution that prepared the runtime.
serverType - Selected server platform.
preparationFingerprint - Effective preparation input fingerprint.
runtimeProtocolVersion - Runtime protocol version.
requiredArtifacts - Immutable durable artifacts required at launch.
sourceInputs - Local inputs examined during setup.
public record IdeRuntimeProvenance(int schemaVersion, String moduleDirectory, String executionId, String serverType, String preparationFingerprint, int runtimeProtocolVersion, List<IdeRuntimeProvenance.Artifact> requiredArtifacts, List<IdeRuntimeProvenance.Artifact> sourceInputs) extends Record
Integrity and input provenance recorded beside a durable IDE runtime manifest.
